$comment: Cache, not authority. Recover it by searching Confluence under rootPageId and Jira for the syncLabel. Drift is detected by remoteVersion, not by a body hash: local files are Markdown and Confluence stores its own format, so a round-tripped hash would flag every page as drifted. If the live version is higher than remoteVersion, a human edited the page. Do not overwrite it; show the divergence and ask.
